### TOYO Co., Ltd to Webcast 2026 Analyst Day


September 23, 2026


TOKYO


, Sept. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[TOYO Co., Ltd](https://www.toyo-solar.com/) (Nasdaq: TOYO; OTC: TOYWF), a solar manufacturing company


, today announced that it will webcast its 2026 Analyst Day on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.


Management will share details regarding the Company's strategy, market trends, and expansion plans.


A live webcast, beginning at 10:30 AM ET, will be available at:[https://app.webinar.net/p7bzgJwmo3E](https://app.webinar.net/p7bzgJwmo3E) . Presentations will conclude at approximately 12:00 PM ET. A replay of the webcast will be available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the event and will remain available for approximately 30 calendar days.


**About TOYO Co., Ltd.**


TOYO is a solar manufacturing company committed to becoming a vertically integrated solar manufacturer provider in the global market, integrating upstream production of wafers and silicon, midstream production of solar cells, downstream production of photovoltaic modules, and potentially other stages of the solar power supply chain. TOYO is well-positioned to produce high-quality solar cells at a competitive scale and cost.
